links.outcome: Biomarker prediction performance across internal and four independent external cohorts
links.effect: FaceFound showed robust results across the internal cohort and four independent external cohorts (N = 206-2,247), with state-of-the-art performance for 45 (73%) of 62 biomarkers.
links.quote: FaceFound consistently outperformed baseline architectures in biomarker prediction, achieving state-of-the-art performance for 45 (73%) biomarkers and demonstrating robust results across internal and four independent external cohorts (N = 206-2,247).

screen.reason: Evaluates a facial foundation model (FaceFound) for multi-system biomarker and disease risk prediction, including mobile app deployment for real-time risk reporting, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
